scope: One independent whole-batch quality web pass covering all 58 frozen REVIEW_ITEMS: 33 proposed shared concepts, 20 existing-owner input families and 5 initial held items. This does not approve a new curated target, round, recipe or board.

criteria: CRITIQUE_RUBRIC A, C, D, F as applicable
literal sense and bundled normalized input ownership
meaningful truthful distinct associations, captions and direction
final aggregate incident neighborhood: 4–8 distinct endpoints, >=2 existing, <=2 batch, >=2 same-category
method.web: Independently opened/searched live Romanian school, museum, conservation, maker and lexical pages during this pass; cached author notes alone were not treated as independent evidence. Search-indexed primary passages were used when the direct PDF/page failed. No dexonline URL was requested; the factual reviewer owns normative DEX/DOOM checks.
method.lexical_independence_limit: Wikționar morphology tables were inspected live; some definitions derive from DEX and are corroboration, not an independent normative authority.
method.ownership: Checked the frozen proposal against bundled normalization_map, existing index/labels/aliases and world snapshots; retained the recorded colliding-form exclusions and original owners.
method.topology: Counted every distinct incident endpoint of the final canonical graph, including incoming links from other proposed items. Declared outgoing lists do not override aggregate caps.
method.target_limit: C3 hidden-target predecessor/engine floors and complete Lanț board route/difficulty approval are outside this shared-concept proposal; outgoing-only anatomical links confer no hidden-target approval.

required_coupled_resolution.incident_count_check: All 29 simulated retained concepts meet every endpoint/category count after these exact drops; apply factual reviewer modifications too, then recompute if any other endpoint is dropped.

summary.decision: Modify before installation. Preserve five initial holds; the four further coupled holds and three edge removals repair the material-neighborhood breaches without inventing evidence. The other item acceptances remain subject to truthful retained links and the factual review.

items.rationale: Familiar winter clothing for a Romanian child. Hand protection, cold weather and wool are concrete associations; the maker describes both child gloves and wool construction. Exact noncolliding feminine inputs remain scoped to the physical object.

Common house-sparrow scope is recognizable near homes. SOR explicitly supports insect feeding and occasional tree nesting. The anatomical Cioc→Vrabie part_of direction is honest; the old unverified wheat link is absent.

Ordinary school/sewing tool with functional cutting and metal links, rather than kit co-listing. School instructions explicitly cut thread with scissors. Keep the exact feminine family; the four unverified Foarfece variants remain held.

Modern wool and its uses are familiar and sourced, but the frozen incident neighborhood has 7 distinct neighbors, including 4 batch concepts, exceeding the cap of 2. This is an aggregate graph failure despite the declared list passing.
requested_changes: Use the documented coupled subset: hold Cuvertură and remove the Lână–Ață edge; retain batch Mănușă/Pulover and existing Oaie/Pătură/Fular.
Recompute every surviving incident neighborhood after all drops: 4–8 distinct, at least 2 existing, at most 2 batch, at least 2 same-category.

items.rationale: The textile-material scope is contemporary and recognizable; shirts and towels are direct uses. The frozen incident neighborhood has 8 neighbors, including 5 batch concepts, exceeding the batch cap.
requested_changes: Hold Cuvertură and Perdea in the coupled subset and remove Bumbac–Pânză. Retain batch Ață/Pulover and existing Haină/Cămașă/Prosop.
Keep textile inputs only; do not add the plant homograph.

items.rationale: Silk is recognizable, but the frozen item is held and supplies no installable four-link proposal. A lexical textile sense does not qualify the missing predeclared use claims.
requested_changes: Keep held; install no node, edges or aliases for this item in this wave.

The bed-cover/blanket and cotton/wool claims are meaningful and familiar, but this concept is the coupled hold chosen to repair the overloaded Lână/Bumbac neighborhoods without inventing replacement links.
requested_changes: Hold the whole item in the documented retained subset; omit its node and all incident edges.
Retain the explicit Cearșaf evidence hold; do not restore that dropped link.

requested_changes: Hold the whole item and all its incident edges in the documented retained subset.

requested_changes: Hold the whole item in the documented subset; omit Draperie→Perdea and all other incident edges.
Do not merge its label/aliases into Perdea or rewrite an existing owner.

items.rationale: A familiar furniture compartment with legible wardrobe, wood, metal and lock relations. Live manufacturer specifications support each material/function; Sertar→Dulap part_of has the correct direction and does not misuse the administrative Birou owner.

Common physical container. The manufacturer explicitly documents wooden-box assembly using driven nails, beyond co-listing nails with packaging. Material captions are qualified to some boxes and avoid gearbox or metaphorical senses.

Recognizable locking device. The manufacturer catalog explicitly gives cabinet/door locks, physical keys and metal construction; some-model captions correctly allow plastic or keyless alternatives. The physical Ușă/Dulap owners fit.

Everyday portable shackle lock. The live product explicitly names cabinet and room/outbuilding-door uses and specifies steel and physical keys. Captions avoid claiming all padlocks require keys and avoid the sports Poartă owner.

A common door handle is recognizable, but the frozen item has no four-link installation proposal and retains its earlier weak generic-hand relation. Modern retail presence cannot replace a distinctive fourth link.
requested_changes: Keep held; do not use generic manual operation to fill the link floor.

items.rationale: Familiar Romanian nature animal, with exact Lutra lutra scope. Conservation and field-guide sources independently support fish, wet habitat and rivers; the mammal identity and graded habitat associations are legible.
Recognizable woodland animal. Romsilva directly verifies acorn feeding and Romanian presence; the domestic-pig connection is ancestry, not the false claim that a wild boar is a domestic pig.

Recognizable river mammal; the conservation guide directly connects Castor fiber with rivers, water levels, trunks and branches. These concrete behavior/habitat links give legible routes without conflating it with unrelated names.
Ordinary school/nature tree with legible fruit, leaf, wood and forest relations. Directed Frunză→Stejar part_of is correct. Rugby-owned stejarii is explicitly excluded; no alias is moved.

Recognizable school/nature fruit with sourced squirrel and boar food associations. Ghindă→Copac is a qualified fruit-part relation through oak, not is_a and not a claim that every tree bears acorns; its direction and caption are honest.

An ordinary anatomical word. Museum and SOR educational material explicitly discuss butterfly and swallow wings; the bee source supplies insect anatomy. All four part_of edges point from the organ to the animal and exclude aircraft sense.

Familiar bird construction, with live SOR examples for storks, swallows and tree nests. The tree caption says some nests and does not wrongly place swallow nests in trees; the neighborhood is legible to children.

Familiar living-animal covering with concrete fox/bear/dog/cat associations. The source examples retain that physical scope. Only blană/blănii are proposed; count plurals for processed pelts or coats remain held.

Recognizable anatomical part, with field-guide and cat anatomy evidence rather than metaphorical gripping tools. The bear/fox/cat/bird endpoints are legible, and part_of direction is correctly from claw to animal.

Ordinary school material with direct notebook/book and writing-tool associations. The manufacturer specifies paper notebook sheets, and school instructions use pencils/pens on drawn sheets. Harta-owned hârtii remains excluded.

Cardboard is familiar and live makers verify box/notebook/book-cover uses. Incoming Lipici makes 3 batch neighbors in the frozen graph, exceeding the cap. The unsupported wood relation is already absent.
requested_changes: Remove Carton→Hârtie is_a from the retained graph for this cap repair.
Retain batch Cutie/Lipici and existing Caiet/Carte, and retain the held Lemn claim as history.

items.rationale: Recognizable glass material with real mirror, jar, window and optical-lens uses. Maker pages corroborate glass mirrors/jars/lenses. Singular-only inputs preserve the material/container boundary; captions do not claim every lens or mirror is glass.

Familiar elastic material. Michelin explicitly places rubber in tyres attached to rims, so the wheel link stays mediated through a tyre; shoe and glove specifications verify everyday uses. Only material-singular inputs are proposed.

Recognizable school/hobby adhesive. The live lesson explicitly repairs a notebook label with glue; the specified hobby glue directly supports paper, cardboard and book binding. This narrow repair claim replaces generic school-kit or industrial-legatory inference.
The sewing needle is familiar, but the folded bare ac key belongs to Aerul condiționat in the live bundled ownership. Lexical plausibility cannot authorize stealing it or silently changing a label.
requested_changes: Keep held; preserve n_v20via_aer_conditionat ownership and install no needle node/aliases/edges.
